This '''planet''' was a colony world that was located in the [[Rim Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Garth Ezzar]] was born and raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Ezzar was teased by other children because of his abilities to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and when he became a teenager, he attacked his childhood tormentors. Ezzar was subsequently imprisoned, but he escaped and lived alone for a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]], as an outcast. Eventually, a [[Garth Ezzar's master|mysterious women]] traveled to the planet and took Ezzar as her apprentice, training him to use the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].
